arguments.value: Joseph III Dawson, born in 1970 in Fort Jackson, South Carolina, is a United States District Judge for the District of South Carolina. He earned a B.A. from The Citadel in 1991 and a J.D. from the University of South Carolina School of Law in 1997. Dawson served with Charleston County, South Carolina, from 1997 to 2020 as assistant county attorney, deputy county attorney, and county attorney, and he maintained a part-time private practice in North Charleston from 2001 to 2020. He also served as a captain in the South Carolina Army National Guard’s JAG Corps from 1999 to 2009 and in the U.S. Army Reserve’s JAG Corps in 2009, and he was a member of the Board of Law Examiners of the South Carolina Judicial Department from 2019 to 2020.
